name: News Bar
author: AlteringUX
description: A second bar along the bottom of every monitor, split in two: world/general-news headlines from configurable RSS/Atom sources on the right (click to open in the browser), and a switchable story feed on the left — Literotica, Confessions, or any listing page you add (one NanoGPT call derives the scrape recipe, then it's cached). Click a title to have the full text read aloud with Piper TTS; click again to stop. A dropdown at the bottom-left switches sources or opens a modal to add one.
